domain_description: Comprehensive regulatory compliance analysis across 12 federal and state regulatory domains including SEC, EPA, OSHA, FERC, FDA, FCC, banking, insurance, energy, environmental permitting, import/export controls, and data privacy. Engines provide doctrine-level guidance grounded in federal statutes, CFR provisions, agency guidance, and enforcement precedent.
authority_sources: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 USC 78a et seq.)
Occupational Safety and Health Act (29 USC 651-678)
Federal Power Act / Natural Gas Act (16 USC 791-828c / 15 USC 717)
Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 USC 301-399i)
Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform Act (12 USC 5301 et seq.)
California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA) (Cal. Civ. Code 1798.100-1798.199)
International Traffic in Arms Regulations (22 CFR 120-130)

engines.name: SEC Compliance Engine
engines.function: Analyze Securities and Exchange Commission compliance requirements including registration, reporting, disclosure obligations, insider trading prevention, broker-dealer regulation, and investment adviser compliance under federal securities laws.
doctrine_topics: investment adviser fiduciary duty and Form ADV

golden_queries.question: A public company CFO learns that next quarter's earnings will miss analyst estimates by 30%. She tells her brother at a family dinner who then sells his shares. Analyze the insider trading liability for both the CFO and the brother under Section 10(b), Rule 10b-5, and tipper-tippee liability.
required_elements: tipper-tippee liability under Dirks v. SEC
failure_signals: failure to analyze both tipper and tippee liability

engines.name: EPA Compliance Engine
engines.function: Analyze Environmental Protection Agency regulatory compliance including air quality permits, water discharge permits, hazardous waste management, Superfund liability, toxic substance controls, and environmental reporting obligations.
doctrine_topics: Clean Air Act Title V operating permit requirements
New Source Review and Prevention of Significant Deterioration
NPDES permit application and compliance (CWA Section 402)
RCRA hazardous waste generator requirements (40 CFR 262)
CERCLA response and cost recovery actions
TSCA chemical reporting and PMN requirements
EPCRA Tier II and TRI reporting
EPA enforcement response policy and penalty calculation

golden_queries.question: An oil and gas production facility emits 120 tons per year of VOCs and 85 tons per year of NOx. The facility has never obtained an air quality permit. Analyze the permitting requirements, potential violations, and the enforcement exposure under the Clean Air Act.
required_elements: penalty calculation methodology under CAA Section 113
failure_signals: failure to address unpermitted operation violation

engines.name: OSHA Compliance Engine
engines.function: Analyze Occupational Safety and Health Administration compliance requirements including general duty clause obligations, specific standards, recordkeeping, workplace inspections, citation defense, and multi-employer worksite liability.

golden_queries.question: An employee falls 18 feet from an unguarded platform at a construction site and suffers serious injuries. OSHA inspects and discovers no fall protection training, no guardrails, and no personal fall arrest systems. The general contractor hired a subcontractor whose employees were working on the platform. Analyze the citations likely issued and the multi-employer defense.
required_elements: multi-employer worksite doctrine (creating, exposing, correcting, controlling)

engines.name: FERC Compliance Engine
engines.function: Analyze Federal Energy Regulatory Commission compliance requirements for natural gas pipelines, electric utilities, hydroelectric projects, and wholesale energy markets including tariff compliance, market manipulation, and reliability standards.
doctrine_topics: Natural Gas Act certificate and rate regulation
electric utility rate regulation and cost recovery
wholesale electric market rules and ISO/RTO compliance
interstate pipeline construction and eminent domain
FERC enforcement and civil penalty authority

golden_queries.question: A natural gas marketing company is accused of manipulating gas index prices by reporting false trade data to price index publishers. Analyze the FERC anti-manipulation authority, potential penalties, and how this differs from CFTC jurisdiction over the same conduct.
required_elements: Energy Policy Act of 2005 penalty authority
penalty calculation (up to $1M per day per violation)

engines.name: FDA Compliance Engine
engines.function: Analyze Food and Drug Administration regulatory compliance including drug and device approval pathways, GMP requirements, labeling requirements, clinical trial regulations, and FDA enforcement actions under the FDCA.
doctrine_topics: clinical trial regulations (IND, IRB, informed consent)
FDA labeling requirements and advertising restrictions
post-market surveillance and adverse event reporting
FDA inspection and warning letter response
FDA enforcement actions (seizure, injunction, consent decree)

golden_queries.question: A company develops a software application that uses AI to analyze medical images and provide diagnostic recommendations. Analyze whether this constitutes a medical device requiring FDA clearance, the appropriate regulatory pathway (510(k) vs De Novo vs PMA), and the Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) framework.
required_elements: clinical decision support software exclusion analysis

engines.name: FCC Compliance Engine
engines.function: Analyze Federal Communications Commission regulatory compliance including spectrum licensing, broadcasting rules, telecommunications regulation, equipment authorization, and emerging wireless technology requirements.
doctrine_topics: RF exposure limits and compliance (47 CFR 1.1307)

golden_queries.question: A company wants to deploy a private 5G network using CBRS spectrum (3.5 GHz band) for industrial IoT applications at an oilfield. Analyze the spectrum access requirements, SAS registration, equipment certification needs, and RF exposure compliance obligations.
required_elements: RF exposure limits for occupational environments

engines.name: Banking Regulations Engine
engines.function: Analyze banking regulatory compliance including capital requirements, consumer protection, BSA/AML obligations, fair lending, and prudential supervision under federal banking statutes and OCC/FDIC/Federal Reserve regulations.
doctrine_topics: Bank Secrecy Act and anti-money laundering (BSA/AML)

golden_queries.question: A regional bank discovers that its BSA/AML monitoring system failed to flag 200 suspicious transactions over 6 months involving shell companies with no apparent business purpose. The transactions total $15 million. Analyze the bank's obligations, potential enforcement exposure, and remediation requirements.
required_elements: OCC enforcement action types (CMP, consent order)

engines.name: Insurance Regulations Engine
engines.function: Analyze insurance regulatory compliance including state licensing, rate filing, solvency requirements, market conduct, claims handling, and producer regulation under state insurance codes and NAIC model laws.
doctrine_topics: McCarran-Ferguson Act and state regulation primacy
insurer licensing and state admission requirements
rate filing and prior approval requirements
NAIC model law adoption and uniformity

golden_queries.question: An insurance company licensed in 3 states wants to offer a new commercial property product in 20 additional states. The product includes a parametric earthquake coverage trigger based on USGS data rather than traditional claims adjustment. Analyze the regulatory pathway for multi-state expansion and product approval.
required_elements: surplus lines alternative if admitted filing is difficult
NAIC Interstate Compact for product approval
failure_signals: failure to address parametric product novelty

engines.name: Energy Regulations Engine
engines.function: Analyze energy industry regulatory compliance including utility rate regulation, renewable energy mandates, energy efficiency standards, pipeline safety, and grid reliability requirements under federal and state energy statutes.
doctrine_topics: state public utility commission rate regulation
electric transmission planning and cost allocation
carbon capture and storage regulatory framework

golden_queries.question: A utility company wants to build a 500 MW solar farm with 200 MWh battery storage in Texas. ERCOT is the grid operator. Analyze the regulatory requirements for interconnection, permitting, and renewable energy credit qualification.
failure_signals: failure to address battery storage regulation

engines.name: Environmental Permits Engine
engines.function: Analyze environmental permitting requirements for industrial and energy projects including air permits, water permits, wetlands permits, waste permits, and endangered species consultations under federal and state environmental statutes.
doctrine_topics: air quality permit types (PSD, NSR, minor source, Title V)
ESA Section 7 consultation and Section 10 HCP
NEPA categorical exclusion vs EA vs EIS

golden_queries.question: An oil company wants to construct a produced water disposal facility in the Permian Basin that will include 3 saltwater disposal wells, a 10-acre evaporation pit, and a truck unloading facility. Identify all federal and state environmental permits required and the timeline for each.
required_elements: UIC Class II disposal well permit (EPA/RRC)
TCEQ air quality permit for VOC emissions
stormwater permit for construction and operation

engines.name: Import Export Controls Engine
engines.function: Analyze trade compliance including export controls (EAR and ITAR), import regulations, economic sanctions (OFAC), customs classification, and free trade agreement compliance under US trade statutes and regulations.
doctrine_topics: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) USML
OFAC sanctions programs and Specially Designated Nationals
deemed export rules for foreign nationals
Foreign Trade Zone benefits and procedures
voluntary self-disclosure to BIS and DDTC

golden_queries.question: A US technology company wants to sell encryption software to a customer in the UAE. The software uses 256-bit AES encryption. A sub-component was developed by a French subsidiary. Analyze the export control classification, license requirements, and any applicable exceptions under the EAR.

engines.name: Data Privacy Engine
engines.function: Analyze data privacy and protection regulatory compliance including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, COPPA, state privacy laws, data breach notification, and cross-border data transfer requirements.
doctrine_topics: GDPR principles and lawful bases for processing
CCPA/CPRA consumer rights and business obligations
HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule requirements
privacy by design and default principles
cookie consent and tracking technology requirements

golden_queries.question: A SaaS company based in Texas serves customers in the US and EU. It processes personal data of 500,000 EU residents and 2 million California residents. It suffers a data breach exposing names, emails, and encrypted passwords. Analyze the notification obligations under GDPR, CCPA, and applicable state breach notification laws, including timelines.
required_elements: GDPR Article 34 data subject notification threshold
risk assessment for encrypted data exposure
failure_signals: failure to address encryption impact on notification
